Messages.Author: pierre rebstock
Messages.Body:
What happens if Beast is the target of Seeds of Corruption?
The rush ability is lost as well as the +1 hand damage, what about the
restriction on action cards and equipment? If beast somehow acquires
some weapons and the seeds are removed, is the equuipment removed?

Tx
Regards, P.

Messages.Author: Noal McDonald
Messages.Body:
pierre rebstock <por...@soton.ac.uk> wrote:
> What happens if Beast is the target of Seeds of Corruption?
> The rush ability is lost as well as the +1 hand damage, what
> about the restriction on action cards and equipment?

Seeds of Corruption prevents a vampire from use of "his or her special
abilities." The restriction on action cards, equipment and retainers is
just that; a restriction, not a special ability. The same thing applies
to all Caitiff and Panders as well. The restrictions/penalties on a
vampire are not affected by Seeds in any way.

> If beast somehow acquires some weapons and the seeds are
> removed, is the equuipment removed?

Moot. He cannot acquire weapons or any other equipment by any means.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
pierre rebstock wrote:
>
> What happens if Beast is the target of Seeds of Corruption?
> The rush ability is lost as well as the +1 hand damage, what about the

> restriction on action cards and equipment? If beast somehow acquires

> some weapons and the seeds are removed, is the equuipment removed?

Seeds of Corruption [AH] - Action (tha) (2)

* "Special ability" includes all non-sect, non-title text. (note that
this only means that the affected vampire cannot do anything that he is
allowed to do only by special ability - not that he can now overcome
some special restriction. Assamites still cannot commit diablerie, for
example) [LSJ 01-AUG-1997]
